verdict_text: NO. The script is not self-contained: it delegates the actual checkpoint I/O and shard-packing logic (including the 268,435,456-byte shard cap and the single-large-tensor-per-shard rule) to an unshown external module `_ckpt.py`, violating the requirement to write a standalone one-off script using PyTorch and `safetensors` directly. Because `save_sharded_safetensors` and `load_checkpoint` are not part of the artifact, the specification's core sharding correctness (Required result item 5) cannot be verified from what was provided. The dtype-casting, buffer-deletion, and required-check logic in the visible code otherwise looks correct, but the missing implementation of the safetensors-writing/sharding logic is a material gap against the "standalone script" instruction.
